sections.title: Soft launch is live
sections.body: Agents Use Cases (use-case directory for vibe coders, builders, and agents) soft-launched this week. Live canonical host is https://agents-use-cases.vercel.app/. Custom domain agentsusecases.ai is planned and not live yet (public DNS NXDOMAIN).

sections.title: Coding agents — editorial Top 3 refresh
sections.body:
We refreshed Best coding agents this week (local catalog; push pending Leon approval):
1. Claude Code — strongest terminal agent for real repos and long sessions.
2. OpenAI Codex (new) — ChatGPT-plan coding agent with CLI, IDE, review, and cloud handoff.
3. OpenCode (new) — open-source agent with a serious 2.0 server/plugin rewrite and multi-surface apps.
Editorial ranks are unpaid and never sold. See /use-case.html?id=coding-agents on the live site.

sections.title: New in catalog
sections.body: Added OpenAI Codex and OpenCode to the seed catalog (marked isNew). Full tool list: /api/tools.json. Prefer /api/rankings.json for resolved editorial + featured.
